RESPALDO · Intro de partículas de Zynora (versión anterior)
Guardado el 3 nov 2026, antes de cambiarla por la intro ligera.

Cómo volver a esta intro: sube este archivo a la conversación y pide "restaurar la intro de partículas".
(Los estilos de esta intro siguen en styles.css, no se borraron.)

================ BLOQUE 1 · HTML (iba justo después de <body> y del <svg> inicial) ================
<div id="intro" aria-hidden="true">
 <canvas id="inBack" class="in-cv"></canvas>
 <div class="in-logo"><img src="img/logo-symbol.png" alt="" draggable="false"></div>
 <div class="in-name">ZYNORA</div>
 <canvas id="inFront" class="in-cv"></canvas>
</div>

================ BLOQUE 2 · SCRIPT (iba dentro del <script> principal, al final) ================
/* ===== Intro cinematográfica: partículas que revelan el símbolo y el nombre =====
   Una vez por sesión · toca para saltarla · 3 versiones que se alternan · respeta "reducir animaciones" */
(function(){
 const el=document.getElementById("intro");if(!el)return;
 if(!document.documentElement.classList.contains("intro-on")){el.remove();return}
 const logoEl=el.querySelector(".in-logo"),nameEl=el.querySelector(".in-name");
 const MASK="data:image/png;base64,";
 const EXIT_AT=4300;let done=false,timer,raf=0;
 function finish(){if(done)return;done=true;clearTimeout(timer);cancelAnimationFrame(raf);el.classList.add("out");try{sessionStorage.setItem("zc_intro","1")}catch(e){}setTimeout(()=>{document.documentElement.classList.remove("intro-on");el.remove()},750)}
 function staticIntro(ms){el.classList.add("static");setTimeout(()=>{logoEl.classList.add("show");nameEl.classList.add("show")},60);timer=setTimeout(finish,ms)}
 let swallowUntil=0;
 const swallow=e=>{if(Date.now()<swallowUntil){e.stopImmediatePropagation();e.preventDefault()}};
 ["pointerup","touchend","mouseup","click"].forEach(ev=>document.addEventListener(ev,swallow,true));
 el.addEventListener("pointerdown",()=>{swallowUntil=Date.now()+600;finish()});
 setTimeout(finish,8000);
 if(zyReduceMotion()){staticIntro(1600);return}
 try{run()}catch(e){staticIntro(2200)}

 function run(){
  const W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight,small=Math.min(W,H)<700;
  const dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,small?1.5:2);
  const cb=document.getElementById("inBack"),cf=document.getElementById("inFront");
  [cb,cf].forEach(c=>{c.width=Math.round(W*dpr);c.height=Math.round(H*dpr)});
  const xb=cb.getContext("2d"),xf=cf.getContext("2d");
  xb.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);xf.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  /* versión: 0 enjambre · 1 marea · 2 espiral (nunca la misma dos veces seguidas) */
  let last=-1;try{last=parseInt(localStorage.getItem("zc_intro_v")||"-1",10)}catch(e){}
  let V;do{V=Math.floor(Math.random()*3)}while(V===last);
  try{localStorage.setItem("zc_intro_v",String(V))}catch(e){}
  const R=Math.random,TAU=Math.PI*2,sc=Math.min(W,H)/420;
  const cl=(x,a=0,b=1)=>x<a?a:x>b?b:x,sm=x=>{x=cl(x);return x*x*(3-2*x)};
  /* sprites (puntos suaves) */
  function sprite(rgb){const c=document.createElement("canvas");c.width=c.height=48;const g=c.getContext("2d");const gr=g.createRadialGradient(24,24,0,24,24,24);gr.addColorStop(0,`rgba(${rgb},1)`);gr.addColorStop(.3,`rgba(${rgb},.85)`);gr.addColorStop(.62,`rgba(${rgb},.18)`);gr.addColorStop(1,`rgba(${rgb},0)`);g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(0,0,48,48);return c}
  const SP=[sprite("255,255,255"),sprite("120,225,255"),sprite("175,150,255")];
  const img=new Image();
  img.onload=()=>{try{start()}catch(e){staticIntro(2200)}};
  img.onerror=()=>staticIntro(2200);
  img.src=MASK;

  function start(){
   /* ---- objetivos: silueta del símbolo y letras del nombre ---- */
   const lr=logoEl.getBoundingClientRect(),nr=nameEl.getBoundingClientRect();
   const M=96,mc=document.createElement("canvas");mc.width=mc.height=M;const mg=mc.getContext("2d");mg.drawImage(img,0,0,M,M);
   const md=mg.getImageData(0,0,M,M).data,LT=[];
   for(let i=0;i<M*M;i++){if(md[i*4+3]>70){const px=i%M,py=(i/M)|0;LT.push([lr.left+(px+R())/M*lr.width,lr.top+(py+R())/M*lr.height])}}
   const cs=getComputedStyle(nameEl),fs=parseFloat(cs.fontSize),ls=parseFloat(cs.letterSpacing)||fs*.42;
   const tc=document.createElement("canvas"),pad=8;tc.width=Math.ceil(nr.width)+pad*2;tc.height=Math.ceil(nr.height)+pad*2;
   const tg=tc.getContext("2d");tg.font=`${cs.fontWeight} ${fs}px ${cs.fontFamily}`;tg.fillStyle="#fff";tg.textBaseline="alphabetic";
   const txt="ZYNORA",ws=[...txt].map(ch=>tg.measureText(ch).width),span=ws.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)+ls*(txt.length-1);
   const asc=tg.measureText("Z").actualBoundingBoxAscent||fs*.7,cx=nr.left+nr.width/2,cy=nr.top+nr.height/2;
   const ox=cx-span/2,oy=cy+asc/2;let xx=ox;
   [...txt].forEach((ch,i)=>{tg.fillText(ch,xx-nr.left+pad,oy-nr.top+pad);xx+=ws[i]+ls});
   const td=tg.getImageData(0,0,tc.width,tc.height).data,NT=[];
   for(let y=0;y<tc.height;y+=1){for(let x=0;x<tc.width;x+=1){if(td[(y*tc.width+x)*4+3]>140&&R()<.55)NT.push([nr.left-pad+x,nr.top-pad+y])}}
   const shuf=a=>{for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=(R()*(i+1))|0;[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a};
   shuf(LT);shuf(NT);
   /* ---- partículas ---- */
   let N=cl(Math.round(W*H/450),560,1100);
   const nL=Math.min(LT.length,Math.round(N*.45)),nN=Math.min(NT.length,Math.round(N*.33));
   const ts=[0,.15,-.05][V],bx=[0,34*sc,0][V],by=[0,-9*sc,0][V],fsp=[1,1.25,.9][V],dir=R()<.5?-1:1;
   const P=[];
   for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    const z=R(),p={z,front:z>.62,r:.55+z*1.55,al:.4+.6*z,s1:R()*TAU,s2:R()*TAU,d:R(),vx:0,vy:0,g:0,tx:0,ty:0,tone:0};
    if(V===0){p.x=R()*W;p.y=R()*H}
    else if(V===1){p.x=-R()*W*.45+R()*W*.3;p.y=R()*H;p.vx=50*sc}
    else{const a=R()*TAU,rad=Math.max(W,H)*(.3+R()*.5);p.x=W/2+Math.cos(a)*rad;p.y=H/2+Math.sin(a)*rad*.9}
    if(i<nL){p.g=1;p.tx=LT[i][0]+(R()-.5)*.8;p.ty=LT[i][1]+(R()-.5)*.8}
    else if(i<nL+nN){p.g=2;p.tx=NT[i-nL][0]+(R()-.5)*.6;p.ty=NT[i-nL][1]+(R()-.5)*.6}
    const q=R();p.tone=q<.06?1:q<.12?2:0;
    P.push(p)}
   shuf(P);
   /* ---- bucle ---- */
   let t0=0,prev=0,fr=0,acc=0,shownL=false,shownN=false,active=P.length;
   function frame(now){
    if(done)return;if(!t0){t0=prev=now}
    const t=(now-t0)/1000;let dt=(now-prev)/1000;prev=now;dt=cl(dt,0,.05);
    if(fr<30&&fr>2){acc+=dt;if(fr===29&&acc/27>.034)active=Math.floor(active*.6)}fr++;
    if(!shownL&&t>2.3){shownL=true;logoEl.classList.add("show")}
    if(!shownN&&t>2.95){shownN=true;nameEl.classList.add("show")}
    xb.clearRect(0,0,W,H);xf.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    const endF=1-sm((t-3.9)/.6),tint=sm((t-2)/1.4)*.8,gl=sm((t-2.5)/.7),gn=sm((t-3.2)/.7);
    for(let i=0;i<active;i++){const p=P[i];
     /* flujo orgánico */
     const sp=(12+p.z*26)*sc*fsp,ang=(Math.sin(p.x*.006+t*.55+p.s1)+Math.cos(p.y*.005-t*.45+p.s2)+Math.sin((p.x+p.y)*.0023+t*.3))*1.55;
     let fx=Math.cos(ang)*sp+bx*(.5+p.z),fy=Math.sin(ang)*sp+by*(.5+p.z);
     if(V===2){const dx=p.x-W/2,dy=p.y-H/2,dd=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;fx+=-dy/dd*sp*.9*dir-dx/dd*sp*.25;fy+=dx/dd*sp*.9*dir-dy/dd*sp*.25}
     let k=0;
     if(p.g===1)k=sm((t-(.7+ts+p.d*.7))/1.4);else if(p.g===2)k=sm((t-(1.6+ts+p.d*.6))/1.4);
     let dvx=fx,dvy=fy;
     if(k>0){let ex=(p.tx-p.x)*3.4,ey=(p.ty-p.y)*3.4;const m=Math.hypot(ex,ey),mx=800*sc;if(m>mx){ex*=mx/m;ey*=mx/m}
      dvx=fx*(1-k)+ex*k;dvy=fy*(1-k)+ey*k}
     const a1=Math.min(1,dt*(3+k*3));p.vx+=(dvx-p.vx)*a1;p.vy+=(dvy-p.vy)*a1;
     p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;
     if(!p.g||k<.2){const mg2=30;if(p.x<-mg2)p.x=W+mg2;else if(p.x>W+mg2)p.x=-mg2;if(p.y<-mg2)p.y=H+mg2;else if(p.y>H+mg2)p.y=-mg2}
     if(k>.9){p.x+=Math.sin(t*2.4+p.s1)*.12;p.y+=Math.cos(t*2.1+p.s2)*.12}
     /* opacidad */
     let a=p.al*sm((t-p.d*.9)/.7)*endF;
     if(p.g===1)a*=1-gl*(p.front?1:.82);else if(p.g===2)a*=1-gn*(p.front?1:.8);else if(p.front&&t>2.2)a*=.6;
     if(a<.012)continue;
     const d=p.r*4.4,c=p.front?xf:xb;
     c.globalAlpha=a;c.drawImage(SP[0],p.x-d/2,p.y-d/2,d,d);
     if(p.tone&&tint>.02){c.globalAlpha=a*tint;c.drawImage(SP[p.tone],p.x-d/2,p.y-d/2,d,d)}
    }
    xb.globalAlpha=1;xf.globalAlpha=1;
    raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame)}
   timer=setTimeout(finish,EXIT_AT);
   raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
 }
})();
